title: Legacy Data Center Consolidation
business: Enterprises operating aging on-premises server infrastructure that require a transition to cloud-native environments.
problem: Organizations often lack visibility into complex inter-server dependencies, leading to broken application functionality when migrating monolithic workloads to the cloud.
solution: Azure Migrate provides a centralized hub for discovery, assessment, and dependency analysis, allowing teams to map network connections between servers before migration to ensure application integrity.
steps: Deploy the Azure Migrate appliance within the local environment to initiate server discovery.
Enable dependency analysis to capture real-time network traffic patterns between servers.
Review assessment reports to identify right-sizing recommendations for target Azure virtual machines.
Execute the migration of validated server groups using the integrated replication tooling.
outcome: A risk-mitigated migration path where application dependencies are preserved, reducing post-migration downtime and configuration errors.
limitation: Dependency analysis relies on agent-based or agentless data collection; if the appliance cannot reach the source servers or if traffic is encrypted in a way that obscures headers, the dependency mapping may remain incomplete. Verify by checking the 'Dependencies' tab in the Azure Migrate portal for missing connection data.
